# Golden parity cases: <name> | <bcli args>
# Outputs in this directory were produced by the Python bcli against
# ../home (see rust/scripts/parity.sh); the Rust binary must match them.
version | --version
list-json | endpoint list -f json
list-ndjson | endpoint list -f ndjson
list-csv | endpoint list -f csv
list-raw | endpoint list -f raw
list-markdown | endpoint list -f markdown
list-custom-markdown | endpoint list --custom -f markdown
list-category-json | endpoint list --custom --category OPS -f json
list-scoped-profile | -p scoped endpoint list -f json
list-auto-records | endpoint list --custom --category ops -f markdown
info-custom-json | endpoint info widgetLines -f json
info-shadowed-json | endpoint info CUSTOMERS -f json
info-standard-json | endpoint info accounts -f json
info-text | endpoint info widgetLines
info-unknown | endpoint info widget
search-none | endpoint search zzzz
error-unknown-profile | -p nope endpoint list -f json
error-profile-typo | -p prdo endpoint list -f json
